sources.title: Codex PROVE candidate README
sources.method: Read the actual local candidate; preserve the scope of workflow claims.

sources.title: Codex PROVE candidate skill
sources.method: Read routing, ownership, handoff and evidence clauses. Reading this as subject matter does not activate the skill.

claims.text: 小任务由当前 Codex 直接完成，零子代理。
claims.excerpt: 当前 Codex 直接完成，零子代理

claims.text: 完整任务由一个 Sol 规划、实现和检查。
claims.excerpt: Sol 自己规划、实现和检查，不另开规划代理

claims.text: Assist 只分析、只评审，不改代码。
claims.excerpt: Sol 分析；具体难题或独立风险评审按需找 Astra，不改代码

claims.text: 多条独立工作线才按需协调并行。
claims.excerpt: Sol 协调并行，明确各自改哪些文件

claims.text: 同一写入范围同时只设一个活跃负责人。
claims.excerpt: Use one active owner per write scope, not one immutable owner forever.

claims.text: 交接前停止原负责人及写入进程，保留检查改动，指定新负责人后再写入。
claims.excerpt:
requires stopping the old worker **and its mutating processes**, preserving and
inspecting its diff, and assigning the new owner before writing resumes.

claims.text: 检查实际文件、差异、测试输出和需求覆盖，不只看汇报。
claims.excerpt:
Review actual
files, diff, outputs, and requirement coverage, not just worker summaries.

claims.text: PASS 需要完整且有证据的需求覆盖。
FIX 表示授权范围内的工作继续。
BLOCKED 表示已没有安全的下一步。
claims.excerpt: BLOCKED means no safe next step is available.

visualSemantics.selectedDirection: First displayed Product Design image, Routing Atlas; user selected 1.
visualSemantics.routes: Four alternatives revealed from the same junction together; not a four-stage sequence.
visualSemantics.scopes: A and B are illustrative independent write scopes, not a fixed team size or file-lock guarantee.
visualSemantics.evidence: Inputs converge toward review; PASS/FIX/BLOCKED are alternatives, not sequential stages or a real run result.
visualSemantics.imageText: Text is baked into generated poster assets, not separately editable typesetting. Edit through supplied prompts or a raster editor.
